analysis:
Both supplied units are BASE-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1711-2101): historical release notes for v0.9.x. The file is documentation only, so I treated it as having no runtime behavior. The patch excerpt, which is truncated and not marked complete, shows the head adds a v0.10.5 candidate section (head lines 11-176) in place of the v0.10.4 header. That head text is outside the supplied units and was not reviewed in detail.

The base excerpts contain no code, secrets, or control changes in this PR, so I found no concrete regression. They do describe security-relevant historical behavior that later threat-model review should keep in view: the T-041 SSD prefix-cache TTL and write-budget changes, the App Attest rotation limits, the removal of the unauthenticated earnings lookup, and fail-closed attestation challenges.

Open integration questions for the head changelog text. The pin changes to the MLX forks and the new metallib hash mean complete SSD checkpoints become per-build namespaced. The T-041 posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, KEK purge) should be confirmed unchanged by the actual source changes. The `darkbloom sandbox` and installer behavior mentioned in the patch excerpt maps to TB-013/T-061, which would need review in the source files, not in this changelog. A changelog edit alone does not alter any control.
